method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

decisions: R001 is changed by open PR 1005; kept. R002 to R005 and MEDULLA-ENGINE-PARITY-R019.1 depend on its two variants `local` and `object-store` and its durability class.
R002: the durable root is manifest-versioned snapshot plus batch segments; the local redb store is a cache. Earlier-version reads are served by the restore tool, not by a new versioned read method.
R003: the Raft leader is the only publisher and the HEAD conditional put is the fence (review recommendation); the local redb store is not the durable authority in object-store mode.

new_rows_requested.title: A node opens a tenant graph from the shared root only with a placement route
